subject: FoundersAlliance stipend swap -> committed discount + sponsor stacking exception
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah@foundersalliance.co>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom@foundersalliance.co>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding stipend -> committed discount (ask)

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and a request from our side: our accelerator provides every cohort company a $5k onboarding stipend (vendor credit) for tooling. We'd like to convert that stipend into a structured discount on committed monthly spend with Redwood for the first 3 months of the pilot.

Specifics we're proposing:
- Convert $5k stipend to an equivalent discount applied against first 3 months of committed spend (we're open to front-loading).
- Allow us to stack a sponsor top-up (sponsor contributes another $2.5k) so the total promotional value is $7.5k.

Our finance team flagged this as a promo-stacking exception — they want confirmation this won't violate Redwood promotional rules and how it will appear on invoices (single consolidated credit vs separate line items). Also attaching our standard SOW for context.

Attachment: FoundersAlliance-Onboarding-Statement.pdf (pdf)

Can you loop in finance/legal and confirm an approach? We need to finalize by next Friday to make the cohort deadline.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Lee
Program Director, FoundersAlliance

From: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah@foundersalliance.co>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding stipend -> committed discount (ask)

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the clear note and the SOW. Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Laura (finance) to confirm what we can do for stacking and invoice presentation. Initial reaction: we can usually convert credit to an upfront discount against committed spend, but sponsor stacking will need a specific carveout and an accounting path (invoice consolidation vs escrow).

Quick asks from our side to speed review:
- Expected monthly token consumption for the pilot (ballpark).
- Whether the sponsor funds are paid to FoundersAlliance or directly to Redwood.
- Can you sign the term-sheet if we draft one with the stacking carveout?

Ben/Laura — any major blockers on a one-off stacking exception? We have a cohort go/no-go next week.

Best,
Priyom
Head of Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference

> Attachment: FoundersAlliance-Onboarding-Statement.pdf (pdf)

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding stipend -> committed discount (ask)

Thanks Priyom — quick internal take from sales ops:

1) Mechanical approach (low-friction): convert the $5k + $2.5k sponsor into a single promotional credit applied to the first invoice(s) as a negative line item. That keeps accounting simple and avoids multiple vendor flows.

2) Alternative (preferred for visibility): structure as a 3-month graduated committed discount tied to a small monthly commit (e.g., $2k/mo commit for 3 months), with the promotional value applied proportionally. This preserves unit economics and gives us a committed baseline to measure consumption.

3) Constraints: finance will need the sponsor funds flow verified. If sponsor pays FA and FA pays us, we need a sponsor agreement clause and an invoice memo.

I attached a quick term-sheet prototype (proposed-term-sheet.xlsx) with the staged discount example and suggested billing lines. Laura — can you confirm accounting treatment and whether we need DocuSign or internal legal sign-off?

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-term-sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding stipend -> committed discount (ask)

All —

Finance perspective: we can accept promo-stacking as a one-off with the following guardrails:
- Sponsor funds must be remitted to FoundersAlliance, and FA must issue a single consolidated payment to Redwood, or FA must provide a signed sponsor contribution memo.
- We will record the total promotional value as an invoice-level credit; accounting prefers one negative line for audit clarity.
- For revenue recognition we need a brief addendum signed (DocuSign link OK) that clarifies the promo stacking and effective applied period.

If Ben's staged-commit approach is used, we will apply the credit across the first three monthly invoices proportional to consumption. That keeps revenue recognition clean and protects our unit economics.

No legal redline needed beyond the addendum unless the sponsor requires co-branding or rights.

Laura
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah@foundersalliance.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding stipend -> committed discount (ask)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks — internal consensus below and an ask to finalize:

- We can convert the $5k onboarding stipend + $2.5k sponsor top-up into a single $7.5k promotional value.
- Option A (preferred): 3-month staged committed discount tied to a $2k/mo minimum commit for months 1–3, with the $7.5k applied proportionally across those invoices. This gives you predictable unit pricing and preserves the sponsor stacking in a single invoice credit.
- Option B: a one-time upfront credit applied to the first invoice (less preferred for revenue recognition).

Next steps we need from you by EOD Thursday:
1) Confirm sponsor flow — will sponsor funds be routed through FoundersAlliance (yes/no)?
2) Confirm expected monthly consumption (ballpark tokens or $ usage).
3) Sign the addendum (DocuSign link): https://www.docusign.net/sign/FA-pilot-2026

If you confirm sponsor flow through FA, Laura will process the stacking exception and we will mark the deal in HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/deal/HSP-FA-2026-0911

If that timeline works, we'll draft the addendum and Ben will follow up with the term-sheet.

Best,
Priyom
Head of Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference

P.S. Hannah — quick note if you prefer a consolidated invoice line item we can do that; just indicate "consolidate" in the DocuSign comment box when signing.
